This was a final paper I worked on in ENV S 140 - Ecology and Management of Wildland Fire. In this paper, we discussed the relationship between wildfire and agriculture, the historical context of agricultural wildland-urban interface (WUI) fires, and how producers can move forward in increasing resilience for themselves and their communities
